title: Sebastian's Cotton Club in Los Angeles: Les Hite, Louis and Hamp
summary: Greer remembers sharing a bill with Les Hite's band in California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: : This was like before Red Norvo and those guys?
Oh, Red, no, ain't nobody ever heard of Hamp. Hamp was playing in California at Sebastian's Cotton Club. Louis was on trumpet, Hamp was playing drums, playing drums --
: Wasn't Les Hite's band, was it?
Les Hite's band. And Lawrence was playing trombone. Ain't ever heard of nobody -- that's the first time we heard Lawrence out there. At Sebastian's Cotton Club.
: This is when you all went out to make a movie?

Yeah. Then they got an engagement out there. We were featured band out there because of all the notoriety. And they was the house band. We used to play together, all of us. That's when Louis would make it 20, 30 of them notes, high notes, on some number he played. That's when Ray Nance stole it. He stole it.
